source: Batch created to wire Mona's completed HubSpot feedback form (T106) into the Command Center UI. Three tasks: data sync extension, Feedback Inbox component, and escalation/support flagging actions. All anchored to p1-2 after T107.

tasks.title: Extend HubSpot sync to pull feedback form submissions and segmentation fields
tasks.description: Mona's feedback form (T106) is live but its submissions are invisible to the board. Extend scripts/sync-hubspot.ts to query the HubSpot Forms API for the feedback form, pull submissions with role, experience, and opt-in fields, normalise them, and write public/data/synced-feedback.json. Includes respondent email, submission timestamp, segmentation (role, experience level), opt-in status, and any free-text response. No UI work in this task — this is the data layer every downstream feedback feature depends on. Gate for T150 and T151.

tasks.title: Build the Feedback Inbox view in the Command Center
tasks.description: A new reusable component (FeedbackInbox.tsx) that reads public/data/synced-feedback.json and displays feedback submissions in a filterable list. Filters: role, experience level, opt-in status, date range. Each row shows respondent segmentation, submission date, a preview of the response, and a link to the HubSpot contact record. Add a new tab or section in the dashboard navigation to surface this view. Model the visual design on the existing Opportunities component for consistency. This is the window into T106's output — without it, the form produces data nobody sees.

tasks.title: Add feedback-to-task escalation and support-request flagging UI
tasks.description: In the Feedback Inbox (T150), add three actions on each submission row: (1) Create Task — opens a mini-form that converts the feedback into a dashboard task anchored to p1-2, pre-filling the respondent's quote and context; (2) Flag for Support — marks the submission as a support request and auto-links it to the engineering FAQ board (T037) or creates a follow-up task; (3) Mark Reviewed — removes the item from the unread queue. This makes T011's feedback contract operational at scale instead of remaining one-off. Also add a Respondents Summary counts bar at the top of the Feedback Inbox (total, this week, by role, opt-in rate).
